candidates.change_summary: Replace 'require(msg.value == 10 ether)' with 'require(msg.value == 11 ether)' to change the required payment amount.
Delete 'require(msg.value == 10 ether)' to allow calls without the exact payment.
Replace 'require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime)' with 'require(block.timestamp >= pastBlockTime)' to allow the same timestamp as the last call.
Delete 'require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime)' to remove the timestamp ordering requirement.
Replace 'pastBlockTime = block.timestamp' with 'pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1' so that the stored time is always one second ahead.
Delete 'pastBlockTime = block.timestamp' so pastBlockTime never updates after the first call.
Replace 'if(block.number % 15 == 0)' with 'if(block.number % 15 != 0)' to invert the condition for transferring balance.
Replace the modulus divisor 15 with 16 in the condition.
Remove the condition completely so the balance is always transferred.
Replace 'payable(msg.sender).transfer(address(this).balance)' with 'payable(msg.sender).transfer(0)' so no funds are transferred even when condition holds.
